findings.change: New internal/storage/sqlite/migrations/db.go defines the migrations.DB handle (Exec/Query/QueryRow/Prepare). All 27 migration functions, the invariant checks, appliedMigrations and recordMigration now take it. RunMigrations takes one *sql.Conn from the pool and runs PRAGMA foreign_keys, BEGIN EXCLUSIVE, every migration, every ledger row, the invariants and COMMIT on that one connection, and restores foreign_keys=ON before returning it to the pool.
findings.code_path: RunMigrations -> sqlDB.Conn(ctx) -> migrationConn -> migration.Func(db) and recordMigration(db, name). No new test: the old behaviour only misfires on a pool-connection swap, which is not deterministically reproducible; the whole existing suite (go test ./...) exercises the new single-connection pass.

notes: Scope beyond the bead's Touches list: item 5 required changing the parameter type of all 27 migration functions from *sql.DB to the new migrations.DB, so every internal/storage/sqlite/migrations/0*.go file and migration_invariants.go are in the commit. No migration logic was changed by that edit.

Restoring foreign_keys=ON on the migration connection before it returns to the pool is new: the old code issued that PRAGMA on whichever connection the pool handed it, so the connection that ran the migrations could stay foreign-keys-off for the rest of the process.
